description: Turn a link you deactivated back on, with its same code and destination. Expired links, links disabled as unsafe, and custom codes that were unassigned can't be reactivated; create a new link instead.

code.description: The link's short code (e.g. AbCdEf, or launch for gajo.io/c/launch). A full short URL also works.

name: reactivate_url

expiresDate.description: ISO-8601 instant; null when the link never expires.

title: Reactivate a short link
